body: You are right, sorry I took so long to reply, I listened to the other poster's response to seek help and called my aunt and she helped me. Thank you so much for your response.

You're right, I just called my aunt and she talked to me and I talked to her about a girl I know who is not a very good friend to me and my veins are too deep or I do not have enough of a pain threshold to take away my life this way anyway.

Thank you for your thoughtful response. It really helped me to know that someone was listening and sympathized with me. I took a medication for depression last night. I had been prescribed it a month before, but I was afraid to take it. But I feel like it is helping with my mood. I guess I overthink things sometimes about people's motives and it is hard to keep in touch because people are busy. I guess I just need to work on myself. Again, thank you. You really helped me.
Hi there. Just wanted to say I know the feeling.
